content.text:
**Here are the 5 most notable recent tweets** (from the last ~48 hours, primarily discussing agent-payment infrastructure on Base and Coinbase’s disclosures on agentic stablecoin volumes; no relevant discussion on AI-judged bounty protocols appeared):

- **@rubelislam0461** (21 likes): Highlights Coinbase’s Q2 2026 Agentic Finance update with standout stats—90% of onchain agentic stablecoin volume on Base, 96% of transactions via x402, and 99% using USDC. Frames Base as the settlement layer, USDC as the payment layer, and x402 as the protocol enabling AI agents to pay for services autonomously.[[1]](https://x.com/rubelislam0461/status/2084067977150775710)

- **@beejorn** (3 likes): Notes Coinbase’s claims of Base handling 90%+ of agentic stablecoin volume and x402 surpassing 100M payments, but questions whether this reflects genuine end-user commerce or internal/manufactured activity, calling for focus on real economic value over transaction counts.[[2]](https://x.com/beejorn/status/2084346736235995465)

- **@iDomCapital**: States that agent payments are emerging as an infrastructure category, citing Coinbase’s Q2 results positioning x402, USDC, and Base as a stack for agentic commerce, with the next layer involving policy, identity, auditability, and interoperability.[[3]](https://x.com/iDomCapital/status/2083372896055902272)

- **@WEB3Seer**: Summarizes Coinbase data in a list—99% of AI agent trading in USDC, 97% of transactions via x402, and 90% of stablecoin volume on Base.[[4]](https://x.com/WEB3Seer/status/2084343441966633114)

- **@ImmovableFaith1** (2 likes): Positions Base (Coinbase L2) as a regulated-friendly hub for consumer + agent finance, citing massive stablecoin volume, x402 leadership, AI-agent tooling, and a 2026 roadmap for tokenized markets and global payments.[[5]](https://x.com/ImmovableFaith1/status/2084203085514109333)

These tweets center on Coinbase’s recent disclosures and the growing agentic payments ecosystem on Base, with a mix of bullish framing and some skepticism about the data’s implications.
